feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 August 2026 11:25pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 16 August 2026 at 11:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure extending from the Azores will decline as various weather fronts affect the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Southwest 3 or 4, veering mainly west overnight, backing southwest again later tomorrow afternoon, then increasing 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight to moderate tomorrow evening.


##Weather##

Rain & drizzle, becoming mainly fair overnight. Outbreaks of rain developing Monday afternoon & evening.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, veering west overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Rain, becoming mainly fair overnight into Tuesday, then showers later in the day.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor at first.
